parse_table_table_content: parse markdown table content within docling_table tags into a 2D list of cells
table_to_markdown_rows: convert a parsed 2D list of table rows back to markdown table format
clean_table_rows: clean a table by removing empty columns and completely empty rows
remove_all_tables_from_documents: remove all docling_table content from documents in a datatrove pipeline
remove_problematic_tables: remove tables with empty headers, empty columns, or empty rows from documents
